############################################################
# CpG methylation pipeline for 4 samples
# A1, A2, ctrl1, ctrl2
############################################################

# 1. Libraries -----------------------------------------------------------
# data.table: fast tables for big genomic files
# ggplot2   : plotting
# stringr   : string helpers
# dplyr     : data wrangling helpers
# scales    : nice axis labels (no 1e+07)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
## 
## Attaching package: 'dplyr'
## The following objects are masked from 'package:data.table':
## 
##     between, first, last
## The following objects are masked from 'package:stats':
## 
##     filter, lag
## The following objects are masked from 'package:base':
## 
##     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union
library(scales)

# Avoid scientific notation in printed numbers and axes
options(scipen = 999)

# 2. Color palette for the samples --------------------------------------
main_fill <- c(
  "A1"    = "#FF6B6B",
  "A2"    = "#92D050",
  "ctrl1" = "#00B0F0",
  "ctrl2" = "#A47DE8"
)

# 3. Helper: histogram where Y axis is percentage ------------------------
plot_hist_pct <- function(x, breaks, title, xlab) {
  # Compute histogram counts, but do not plot yet
  h <- hist(x, breaks = breaks, plot = FALSE)
  df <- data.frame(mid = h$mids, count = h$counts)
  df$perc <- df$count / sum(df$count) * 100   # convert to %

  ggplot(df, aes(mid, perc)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#4C7BA8", color = "white", alpha = 0.95) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = ifelse(perc < 0.5, "", sprintf("%.1f%%", perc))),
      vjust = -0.4, size = 3
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x     = xlab,
      y     = "Percentage of CpGs (%)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}

# 4. Files and sample names ---------------------------------------------
files.list <- list.files(
  "/Users/rafae/Documents/Methyl/",
  pattern   = "*CpG_report.txt",
  full.names = TRUE
)

sample_info <- data.table(
  sample = c("A1", "A2", "ctrl1", "ctrl2"),
  path   = files.list[1:4]
)

# 5. Function to process ONE sample -------------------------------------
process_sample <- function(path, sample_name,
                           bin_size            = 10000L,
                           max_points          = 200000L,
                           max_points_scatter  = 200000L) {
  # Read CpG report as a table
  dt <- fread(
    file   = path,
    sep    = "\t",
    header = FALSE,
    col.names = c("chr", "pos", "strand", "numC", "numT", "dinuc", "trinuc"),
    showProgress = TRUE
  )

  # Keep only rows where chromosome name starts with "chr"
  dt <- dt[str_detect(chr, "^chr")]

  # Coverage = methylated reads + unmethylated reads
  dt[, coverage := numC + numT]

  # Coverage distribution table
  cov_dist <- dt[, .(bases = .N), by = coverage][order(coverage)]
  cov_dist[, frac := bases / sum(bases) * 100]
  cov_dist[, sample := sample_name]

  # Methylation for all coverages (used in scatterplot)
  dt[coverage > 0, meth_all := numC / coverage]

  scatter_dt <- dt[coverage > 0 & !is.na(meth_all),
                   .(coverage, meth_all)]
  if (nrow(scatter_dt) > max_points_scatter) {
    scatter_dt <- scatter_dt[sample(.N, max_points_scatter)]
  }
  scatter_dt[, sample := sample_name]

  # Filter CpGs with coverage between 10 and 50
  sub <- dt[coverage > 10 & coverage < 50]

  # Per-CpG methylation in this range
  sub[coverage > 0,
      `:=`(
        meth         = numC / coverage,        # 0–1
        meth_percent = 100 * numC / coverage   # 0–100
      )]

  cov_full <- sub[coverage > 0 & !is.na(meth)]

  # Global metrics
  global_meth      <- cov_full[, mean(meth)]
  global_meth_high <- cov_full[meth >= 0.7, .N] / cov_full[, .N]

  metrics <- data.table(
    sample    = sample_name,
    mean_meth = global_meth,
    frac_high = global_meth_high
  )

  # Downsample CpGs for violin plot
  if (nrow(cov_full) > max_points) {
    cov_plot <- cov_full[sample(.N, max_points)]
  } else {
    cov_plot <- cov_full
  }
  cov_plot[, sample := sample_name]

  # Genomic bins (10 kb windows)
  cov_full[, bin    := paste(chr, pos %/% bin_size, sep = "_")]
  cov_full[, sample := sample_name]

  bins <- cov_full[!is.na(bin),
                   .(meth = mean(meth, na.rm = TRUE)),
                   by = .(sample, bin)]

  # Methylation categories per CpG
  cov_full[, meth_class := case_when(
    meth < 0.1 ~ "Unmethylated",
    meth < 0.3 ~ "Low",
    meth < 0.7 ~ "Partial",
    meth < 0.9 ~ "High",
    TRUE       ~ "Fully"
  )]

  meth_summary <- cov_full[, .N, by = .(sample, meth_class)]
  meth_summary[, percent := N / sum(N) * 100]

  # Values needed for histograms
  hist_vals <- cov_full[, .(
    sample,
    coverage,
    meth_percent
  )]

  list(
    cov_dist     = cov_dist,
    cov_sample   = cov_plot,
    bins         = bins,
    meth_summary = meth_summary,
    metrics      = metrics,
    scatter      = scatter_dt,
    hist_vals    = hist_vals
  )
}

# 6. Run pipeline for all 4 samples -------------------------------------
res_list <- lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(sample_info)),
  function(i) process_sample(sample_info$path[i], sample_info$sample[i])
)

# Combine lists into big tables
cov_dist_all     <- rbindlist(lapply(res_list, `[[`, "cov_dist"))
cov_sample_all   <- rbindlist(lapply(res_list, `[[`, "cov_sample"))
bins_all         <- rbindlist(lapply(res_list, `[[`, "bins"))
meth_summary_all <- rbindlist(lapply(res_list, `[[`, "meth_summary"))
metrics_all      <- rbindlist(lapply(res_list, `[[`, "metrics"))
scatter_all      <- rbindlist(lapply(res_list, `[[`, "scatter"))
hist_vals_all    <- rbindlist(lapply(res_list, `[[`, "hist_vals"))

############################################################
# PLOTS
############################################################

# 7. Coverage distribution per sample (<= 50x) ---------------------------
ggplot(cov_dist_all[coverage <= 50],
       aes(x = coverage, y = frac, color = sample)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = main_fill) +
  labs(
    title = "Coverage distribution per sample",
    x = "Sequencing depth",
    y = "Fraction of bases (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

# 8. Global CpG methylation per sample ----------------------------------
ggplot(cov_sample_all,
       aes(x = sample, y = meth, fill = sample)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7, trim = TRUE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, fill = "white", outlier.size = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = main_fill) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Global CpG methylation per sample (coverage 10–50)",
    x = "",
    y = "Methylation level"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

# 9. Mean methylation per 10 kb bin -------------------------------------
ggplot(bins_all,
       aes(x = sample, y = meth, fill = sample)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7, trim = TRUE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, fill = "white", outlier.size = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = main_fill) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean CpG methylation per 10 kb bin",
    x = "",
    y = "Mean methylation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

# 10. Methylation class distribution ------------------------------------
ggplot(meth_summary_all,
       aes(x = meth_class, y = percent, fill = sample)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", percent)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 3.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = main_fill) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    title = "CpG methylation state distribution",
    x = "Methylation class",
    y = "Percentage of CpGs (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

# 11. Coverage vs methylation scatter (all depths) ----------------------
ggplot(scatter_all,
       aes(x = coverage, y = meth_all, color = sample)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = main_fill) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, quantile(scatter_all$coverage, 0.99))) +
  labs(
    title = "Coverage vs CpG methylation (all depths)",
    x = "Coverage",
    y = "Methylation (numC / coverage)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  facet_wrap(~ sample)

# 12. Histograms in percent for each sample -----------------------------
# Coverage 10–50
for (s in unique(hist_vals_all$sample)) {
  tmp <- hist_vals_all[sample == s]
  print(
    plot_hist_pct(
      x      = tmp$coverage,
      breaks = 50,
      title  = paste("Coverage 10–50 -", s),
      xlab   = "Coverage"
    )
  )
}

# % CpG methylation (10–50)
for (s in unique(hist_vals_all$sample)) {
  tmp <- hist_vals_all[sample == s]
  print(
    plot_hist_pct(
      x      = tmp$meth_percent,
      breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 5),
      title  = paste("% CpG methylation (coverage 10–50) -", s),
      xlab   = "% methylation per base"
    )
  )
}
